notes.title: Version 0.3.0.0 Released
notes.content: [h3]Additions:[/h3][list][*][p]Remade the wood collection minigame background. There are now layers that dynamically change with the weather.[/p][/*][*][p]Added weather effects to the wood collection minigame.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an in-game progression system. Earn XP by completing runs and unlock new things.[/p][/*][*][p]Added something secret.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 0.2.0.0 Released
notes.content: [h3]Additions[/h3][list][*][p]Added a "mental health" bar above survivors[/p][/*][*][p]Added an "energy" bar above survivors[/p][/*][*][p]Added small icons next to all status bars to improve readability[/p][/*][*][p]Added the "sleep" status[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to progress through days[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to cycle through actions by clicking the actions above or below the currently selected action[/p][/*][*][p]Added a debug FPS tracker to monitor fps during development[/p][/*][/list][h3]Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Survivors recover +2 energy overnight instead of +1 energy[/p][/*][*][p]Talking no longer requires an action point nor does it consume energy[/p][/*][/list]
